shapes.author: agent
shapes.text:
Key: frames = trust/deployment zones; box = runtime actor/process; cylinder = stored state; double border = external
service. Arrows: caller → recipient, response included; dotted = local command/I/O; solid = sync. Flow type is also written on
each arrow.

shapes.author: agent
shapes.text:
Chrome runs with
--remote-debugging-port on 127.0.0.1,
and the handle stores its http/ws
URLs. Any local process that can reach
the port can drive the logged-in
browser.

shapes.author: agent
shapes.text:
Vault key; or
CRUMB_KEY env /
key file

shapes.author: agent
shapes.text:
Every 30s (configurable, 0 = off), on
SIGUSR2 (crumb sync) and
SIGTERM/SIGINT it saves a merged
snapshot; errors are only logged.
Closing the window exits with no final
save.

shapes.author: agent
shapes.text:
A live handle is returned with no new
spawn. Missing account →
NOT_FOUND; empty → NEEDS_LOGIN.
Supervisor errors (e.g.
KEY_UNAVAILABLE) go to the error
file; exit or 60s → INTERNAL.

shapes.author: agent
shapes.text:
New engineers · The crumb launch path: detached supervisor, vault decrypt and inject, handle file, CDP URL and autosave back to
the vault.

shapes.author: agent
shapes.text: Outside this view: login, capture, check, close and transfer commands; Agent-side CDP use after the handle is returned.
